study: Q-SHIFT Phase 2B Pauli-biased noise decoder specialization
classification: exploratory simulation study; no adaptive controller

noise.pauli_channel_2_weight_rule: For each non-II pair AB, unnormalized mass is w(A)*w(B), with w(I)=1 and w(X,Y,Z) set by regime; normalize the 15 masses to the configured total gate fault probability.

seed_allocation.cell_index_order: memory basis z, x; within basis x_biased, balanced, z_biased

decoder_bank.global_fixed_selection: For each memory basis, minimize the equal-regime mean calibration LER over the three models; ties go to lowest index.
decoder_bank.regime_selected_comparator: For each memory basis and generating regime, minimize calibration LER over the three models; ties go to lowest index.

statistics.primary: Equal-weight mean across the six memory-basis x generating-regime cells of (calibration-selected regime-index prediction LER minus calibration-selected per-basis global-fixed LER).
statistics.cluster_unit: Independent Stim RNG root within each basis-regime cell.
statistics.primary_test: Two-sided paired root-cluster sign-flip Monte Carlo test, 100000 assignments, add-one p-value.
statistics.primary_ci: 95% percentile bootstrap, 100000 resamples, independently resampling roots within each of the six cells and averaging the six cell means.
secondary_families: Two per-memory-basis primary contrasts, Holm adjusted.
Twelve alternative-model-versus-global-fixed paired root comparisons (two alternatives per cell), Holm adjusted.
statistics.shotwise_test: Exact two-sided McNemar per comparator and stratum, descriptive only; root-cluster inference is primary.
